tool_selection.reasoning: SHAP provides globally interpretable, game-theoretic feature importance suitable for tabular data and aligns with model logic. LIME offers local interpretability by generating simpler models around the prediction. Integrated gradients provide smooth, gradient-based attributions from baseline.
